steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the draft creation flow.
Apply the tenant configuration required by the case.
Apply the remaining configuration required by the case.
Give the draft a known title so it can be found in Drafts.
Configure the eRFX draft with the RFQ stage required by the case.
Configure the RFQ stage before adding its template and items.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the draft can contain a pricing sheet.
Add a line item to make the draft a usable eRFX draft.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Save the eRFX project as the draft under test.
Return to the events list to reopen the saved draft through the buyer flow.
Verify the events list rendered before selecting Drafts.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved eRFX draft should appear.
Confirm the saved draft is present in the Drafts list.
Open the saved draft and return to its create screen.
Open the Participants control on the saved draft.
Verify that the All Vendors window opened.
Verify the vendor search field is available in the window.
Verify the Invite action is present.
Verify the Filters action is present.
Verify the Cancel action is present without pressing it.
Verify the Save action is present without pressing it, leaving the event unchanged.
Confirm opening the Participants window did not produce an application error.
